snippet.title: A Game About Mining Rocks - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Hey everyone!
I’m super excited to finally share the trailer for my first indie game: A Game About Mining Rocks! 🎮
It’s a mining game inspired by A Game About Digging a Hole. You’ll explore underground caverns, mine resources, upgrade your gear, and uncover some strange secrets buried deep below.
